authorization_reference: User authorizes both hourly GPU machines, installations and direct short experiments. This independently locked baseline block is bounded 4800s total,900s/cell,90GiB; no resource purchases.
hypothesis: Test whether adapted BidKV may safely select a qualified already-scheduled pure-decode prefix victim when a native allocation fails; separate mechanism qualification from service outcomes.
action_difference: All arms retain native-full saving, ordinary backfill, FCFS, Q1, no forced rotation, guard off, and continuation off. Tail uses native tail; suffix BidKV uses the existing unprocessed suffix; full BidKV also permits already-scheduled qualified prefix candidates and applies native-style rollback before the original preempt/retry path.
mechanism_criteria: All three complete128/native-full/forced0, every victim decision joins actual same-step native preemption. Full arm must make at least one prefix choice. Every prefix choice needs qualified earlier scheduled candidate, positive token refund and complete scheduled/KV/spec/encoder plan rollback, req_index decrement, selected absent from native output plan/present in native preempted IDs, plus independent raw same-call preemption and no victim new-token output. Victim later output/completion/failure retained.
service_criteria: DESCRIPTIVE and separate from implementation qualification: full versus BOTH tail and suffix controls, actual output rate >=97%, mean flow <=105%, strictly lower maximum request gap. Report complete 128-request differences, 20 fixed goodput points and natural output/stop differences. Lower service does not invalidate verified rollback.
retention_rule: One fixed three-cell block tail_break,bidkv_suffix_break,bidkv_full_break in that order, all outcomes retained. Same already-seen128 inputs and pinned score/ties; no parameter or input tuning, no new-method or fresh-confirmation claim.
claim_ceiling: CPU-tested baseline completeness candidate until real native allocation/preemption receipts qualify it. Prefix choice may shift stalls to a different request and does not reproduce the complete upstream BidKV system.
resource_retry: One new session with 1.25 GiB system-disk reserve after three private copies of the completed A runtime cache; no automatic retry after a cell starts.
